verdict.rationale: First-party docs say services can be instrumented with OpenTelemetry and that OTel data can be integrated with New Relic for analysis, so OpenTelemetry is a supported ingestion path. However, the evidence never mentions an OTLP endpoint or sending telemetry directly over OTLP, and it gives no detail on how first-class the support is compared with the proprietary agents. Missing for 10: explicit OTLP endpoint/protocol documentation, evidence of direct OTLP export without proprietary agents, depth on first-class OTel features (semantic conventions, signals supported), independent or hands-on corroboration.
